title: Editing Guide: Crown HVAC Service
summary: Editing guide for Crown HVAC Service shoot across two locations.
content:
Editing Guide: Crown HVAC Service (Two Locations)

Project: Ambition Mechanical 2026 Resolve Project: Ambition 2026 (Resolve Cloud) Shoot Date: March 5, 2026 Guide Created: March 12, 2026 Source: /Volumes/SS8TB/Ambition Mechanical Services/20260305 Crown/

Quick Reference

Metric Value
Total clips (Ronin4D) 66 (C0004-C0069)
Drone videos 7
Drone photos 5 JPGs (~30MP each)
DJI MIC recordings 3 WAVs (61 min total)
Total footage duration ~28 min video + 61 min audio
Total footage size 111 GB (45G Ronin, 10G Drone, 673M MIC, 55G organized copies)
Camera DJI Ronin 4D, Reel B006_HL9406
Video format ProRes 4K (3840x2160) 24fps, PCM 24-bit 48kHz stereo
Drone format HEVC 2.7K (2688x1512) or 4K (3840x2160) 59.94fps
DJI MIC format PCM 32-bit float 48kHz mono
Color profile Flat/log (needs color grade)
Lens Crown Room: 50mm f/1.8 (C0004), 28mm f/1.8 (C0005-C0006), 17mm f/1.8 (C0007-C0035). Memorial Tower: 17mm f/2.8 (C0036-C0068), 28mm f/2.8 (C0069)

Shoot Timeline (AZ Time)

All creation times from file metadata. UTC offsets applied (AZ = UTC-7).

7:48 AM  -- DJI MIC 1 starts (lav recording, pre-camera)
8:19 AM  -- DJI MIC 1 ends / MIC 2 starts
8:43 AM  -- DJI MIC 2 ends
8:48 AM  -- DJI MIC 3 starts
8:50 AM  -- C0004: First Ronin4D clip (Ambition truck, 50mm)
8:55 AM  -- DJI MIC 3 ends
8:50-9:24 AM -- Crown Room rooftop shooting (C0004-C0035)
             -- Lens change at C0005 (50mm -> 28mm)
             -- Lens change at C0007 (28mm -> 17mm, stays here through C0035)
9:24 AM  -- C0035 ends. Crew wraps Crown Room.
9:27 AM  -- Drone flights begin (0007-0009, first battery)
9:32 AM  -- Drone 0009 ends
9:43 AM  -- Drone 0010-0011 start (second battery, different angle)
9:48 AM  -- C0036: Memorial Tower shooting begins
             -- Aperture change (f/1.8 -> f/2.8 for indoor mechanical room)
9:49 AM  -- Drone 0012-0013 overlap with Memorial Tower shooting
9:52 AM  -- C0037: HERO walking tour begins (3:31)
10:10 AM -- C0069: Last clip. Memorial Tower shooting ends.

Gap analysis from timeline:

  • 24-minute gap between Crown Room (ends 9:24) and Memorial Tower (starts 9:48) = travel time
  • Drone shots happened during this gap (9:27-9:52), overlapping slightly with Memorial Tower start
  • Lav recordings all ended by 8:55 AM, over 50 minutes before Memorial Tower

LOCATION 1: Crown Room (C0004-C0035)

Site: Crown Room at Hotel San Carlos, downtown Phoenix. Historic 1928 building, 7 stories, Italian Renaissance Revival. Kitchen fire restoration project requiring HVAC exhaust system replacement.

Shooting window: 8:50 - 9:24 AM (34 minutes)

Clip-by-Clip Breakdown

Establishing Shots

Clip Duration Timecode Lens Audio (mean/max) Speech Band Notes
C0004 0:05.7 05:50:56:13 50mm f/1.8 -35.4/-19.8 dB -- Ambition branded truck in parking structure. Shallow DOF. Only 50mm clip.
C0005 1:45 05:51:02:06 28mm f/1.8 -33.5/-8.5 dB -36.6 mean Wide rooftop, worker in safety vest among HVAC units. Extended coverage, some tool/work sounds create peaks. No clear speech detected.
C0012 0:05 05:55:57:06 17mm f/1.8 -39.8/-24.0 dB -- Wide rooftop from above with tile roof detail. Quiet.
C0017 0:09.5 05:56:42:07 17mm f/1.8 -36.5/-18.2 dB -- Worker standing on roof edge overlooking commercial area. HERO COMPOSITION. Best poster/thumbnail frame.
C0033 0:25.7 05:59:50:09 17mm f/1.8 -31.6/0.0 dB -35.1 mean Interior: warehouse/shop establishing + kitchen walkthrough. Burst of sound at 15-20s (mean -31.4 dB speech band) suggests conversation or loud equipment. Possible speech but likely incidental.
C0034 2:11 06:00:16:01 17mm f/1.8 -29.3/-0.8 dB -30 to -35 mean Interior kitchen: ceiling ductwork + commercial kitchen. Loudest sustained audio of Crown Room clips. First 70s have steady sound (mean -30 to -32 dB speech band), drops off after 90s. This is ambient kitchen/work noise, not clear speech. Could contain distant conversation.
C0035 1:07 06:02:27:08 17mm f/1.8 -39.9/-12.2 dB -41 to -47 mean Parking garage. Crew exits door, walks to branded Ambition truck. Quiet environment. Perfect opening or closing shot.

Crown Room Audio Summary

No clear speech detected in any Crown Room Ronin4D clips. The audio is dominated by:

  • Rooftop ambient (wind, HVAC hum): -38 to -40 dB mean
  • Tool/work sounds (impacts, metal scraping): peaks to 0.0 dB in C0006, C0033
  • Indoor ambient (kitchen, ductwork): -29 to -31 dB mean in C0034

The loudest clips (C0033, C0034) have sustained environmental noise from the indoor kitchen/mechanical spaces but no distinguishable speech patterns in the speech frequency band.

For audio in the edit: Use these clips for ambient sound design. The tool sounds in C0006, C0025-C0030 are authentic work audio. The DJI MIC recordings capture the crew's early morning work (see Audio section below).

AERIAL (Drone Air 3)

Shot during the travel gap between locations (9:27-9:52 AM).

Clip Duration Resolution FPS Time (AZ) Notes

0012 0:22 2.7K 59.94 9:49 AM Orbit/pan of surrounding area.

No audio on drone clips (no audio streams detected).

Proxy files available at DRONE AIR3/Proxy/ for all 7 clips (.mov format).

Total drone duration: 12:20

LOCATION 2: Memorial Tower (C0036-C0069)

Site: Memorial Tower, Phoenix. Senior living high-rise. Long-term HVAC project. Central mechanical plant with chillers, pumps, Trane building automation.

Shooting window: 9:48 - 10:10 AM (22 minutes)

Key change: Aperture shifted to f/2.8 (from f/1.8 at Crown Room) for indoor mechanical room lighting.

TALKING SHOTS (The Money Clips)

These are the clips with confirmed speech activity. All camera mic only (no lav coverage at this location).

Clip Duration Timecode Audio (mean/max) Speech Band Mean Speech Assessment
C0037 3:31.8 06:04:11:11 -24.9/-2.2 dB -21.8 to -30.3 dB HERO CLIP. Continuous speech throughout. Loudest speech at 60-110s (mean -21.8 to -24.3 dB). Full walking tour with crew member explaining HVAC systems.
C0036 0:37.1 06:03:34:08 -28.7/-8.2 dB -28.3 to -33.9 dB Loading dock/parking area walkthrough. Speech activity increases 20-30s. Crew member exits building, walks past branded truck. Good opening.
C0041 0:23.1 06:08:11:21 -21.3/-7.2 dB -21.3 to -23.2 dB Large HVAC unit walkthrough with STRONG speech throughout. Consistent volume, close-mic distance. Excellent supplemental to C0037.
C0039 0:06.1 06:07:50:20 -23.5/-10.9 dB -24.8 mean Piping/valves with off-camera voice. Brief cutaway with talking.
C0040 0:14.9 06:07:56:23 -24.0/-11.1 dB -25.3 mean Same as C0039, different pipe angle. Voice continues.
C0042 0:05.3 06:08:34:23 -17.7/-6.7 dB -19.8 mean Trane control panel with CLEAR speech. Loudest speech-band of all clips. Close to the panel, likely pointing at it while talking.
C0043 0:06.6 06:08:40:05 -16.5/-5.0 dB -18.8 mean Trane control panel, different angle. LOUDEST OVERALL. Best audio quality of any clip.

Establishing

DJI MIC (Lav Recordings)

Three lav recordings, all captured BEFORE the main camera started rolling.

File Duration Time (AZ) Mean Vol Max Vol Speech Activity
DJI_11_074859 30:46 7:48-8:19 AM -36.9 dB 0.0 dB Sporadic. Mostly quiet ambient with peaks at 13-15 min (-31 to -32 dB speech band) and 30-31 min (-31.4 dB). Rest is -38 to -55 dB. Early morning setup sounds.
DJI_11_081946 23:44 8:19-8:43 AM -23.3 dB -0.7 dB MOST SPEECH. Sustained talking at 0-2 min, 9-16 min, 19-22 min (speech band -30 to -33 dB). Clear work conversation. Quiet gap 5-9 min (-50 to -56 dB).
DJI_12_084830 6:47 8:48-8:55 AM -25.7 dB 0.0 dB Active speech first 5 min (speech band -23 to -29 dB). Dies off after 5 min. Only lav that overlaps with any video (C0004, at offset ~2:07).

Lav-to-Video Sync Status

Critical finding: The lav recordings ended at 8:55 AM. The first Ronin4D clip (C0004) starts at 8:50 AM. Only 5 minutes of overlap, and only one clip (C0004, 5.7 seconds) falls within the lav recording window.

  • DJI_12_084830 overlaps with C0004 at approximately offset 2:07 into the lav recording
  • No lav coverage for C0005-C0069 (all filmed after 8:55 AM)
  • No lav coverage for Memorial Tower (filmed 9:48-10:10 AM)

Bottom line for editing: The lavs are NOT sync audio for the talking shots. They are supplemental ambient/work audio from the early morning setup. Use them for:

  1. Authentic crew audio texture (layered under b-roll)
  2. Work sounds / SFX library elements
  3. The brief speech segments could potentially be used as voiceover if the content is relevant

See crown-room-sync-map.md for the full audio alignment analysis.

Content Ideas (Ranked by Impact)

Tier 1: High Impact

1. "The Tour" (60-90s LinkedIn/IG Reel) The C0037 walking tour is a ready-made piece. The crew member walks through an active mechanical room explaining systems to camera. Structure:

  • Open with drone (0013 4K or 0007 orbit) establishing the building
  • Cut to C0036 (loading dock arrival)
  • C0037 at 1:00-1:50 as the core (best audio, active explanation)
  • Intercut with detail shots (C0045-C0055 rapid montage) when he references specific equipment
  • C0042/C0043 as punch-in moments (Trane panels, loudest clearest audio)
  • Close with drone pull-back (0009)
  • Text overlays for key technical terms

Why it works: Shows expertise, scale, and professionalism. The walking tour format performs well on LinkedIn (education + authority). Construction companies rarely show the technical depth of mechanical work.

2. "Two Jobs, One Day" (30-45s IG Reel) Cross-cut between both locations to show the scale of Ambition's operations.

  • Crown Room rooftop exhaust work (C0006, C0017 hero shot, C0025 teamwork)
  • Memorial Tower mechanical room (C0037 talking, C0044 dolly, C0056 pump)
  • Drone as transition between locations
  • High energy, fast cuts, beat-driven

Why it works: Shows range and volume. Construction audiences love seeing busy companies because it signals reliability.

3. Project Showcase: Crown Room Fire Restoration (60s) Tell the story of restoring HVAC to a historic Phoenix building after a kitchen fire.

  • Drone establishing (the building is visually impressive for Phoenix)
  • Rooftop work: old fan disassembly (C0006-C0010)
  • Kitchen interior: ductwork (C0034)
  • Detail shots of equipment (C0007-C0014)
  • Crew teamwork moments (C0025, C0027)
  • End on truck shot (C0004 or C0035)
  • Text overlay: "Restoring [Hotel Name] after a kitchen fire. Nearly 100 years old. Modern code, historic building."

Tier 2: Medium Impact

4. "Behind the Panels" (30s Educational) Close-up on Trane control panels (C0042, C0043) with voiceover from the crew member explaining building automation. These clips have the clearest audio of the shoot.

  • Good for LinkedIn (technical audience loves BAS content)
  • Pair with text overlays explaining what each panel does

5. Detail Montage / B-Roll Reel (15-30s) The C0045-C0055 sequence was shot specifically for this. 11 consecutive pipe/valve close-ups at varying angles. Add:

  • C0038 (colorful green/red valves)
  • C0056 (strong low-angle pump)
  • Speed ramp through the sequence
  • Music-driven, no dialogue needed
  • Use as a "satisfying" or "oddly satisfying" construction reel

6. Crew Culture: "The Walk" (15-30s) C0035 (parking garage to truck) and C0036 (loading dock exit) are both walking sequences showing the crew in motion.

  • Slow-mo potential (24fps ProRes holds up to 50% speed)
  • Music-driven, brand stinger
  • Shows the human side

Tier 3: Supplemental

7. Drone Showcase (15-30s) Pure aerial reel using 0007, 0009, 0011, 0013. Good for general brand awareness.

8. "The Details" (Static Posts) Extract still frames from:

  • C0017 (hero rooftop composition)
  • C0056 (low-angle pump)
  • C0042/C0043 (Trane panels)
  • Drone photos (5 JPGs) Use for LinkedIn carousel or IG static posts.

[0:43-0:48] C0037 @ 1:40-1:45 -- wrapping point

Structure B: Two-Location Showcase

[0:05-0:10] C0005 -- rooftop wide work

Structure C: Rapid-Fire Montage (Music-Driven, No Dialogue)

Beat-synced cuts, 0.5-1.5s each:
C0017 > C0006 > C0008 > C0025 > C0028 > C0031 >
C0038 > C0044 > C0045 > C0047 > C0050 > C0053 >
C0056 > C0060 > C0063 > C0066 > Drone 0007 > Drone 0013
Total: ~18 cuts in 30s

Gaps and Issues

  1. No lav sync for talking shots. All speech relies on camera mic audio. C0037's mic is usable but not broadcast quality. Consider noise reduction in Resolve (Fairlight) for the speech segments, especially removing the mechanical room hum.

  2. No before/after. No shots of the old equipment or pre-work state at either location.

  3. Single camera angle on C0037. The 3:31 walking tour is one continuous shot. You'll need to cut away to b-roll to avoid visual monotony, but the audio continuity is the strength.

  4. No client testimonial. No building manager or facility owner on camera.

  5. No finished product shots. Everything is work-in-progress. No "here's the completed install" moment.

  6. No team group shot. Social media loves crew photos.

  7. C0068-C0069 are quieter. Audio drops significantly (-37 to -39 dB mean) suggesting a different room or area. These may feel disconnected from the rest of the Memorial Tower footage.

  8. Drone clips are 59.94fps. Ronin4D is 24fps. When intercutting, the drone clips need frame rate handling in Resolve (interpret as 24fps for smooth slow-mo, or leave at 60fps and let Resolve handle the mixed timeline).

DaVinci Resolve Import Notes

Timeline Setup

  • Project frame rate: 24fps (match Ronin4D)
  • Resolution: 3840x2160 (4K UHD)
  • Color space: DaVinci Wide Gamut / Resolve Color Managed (recommended for flat/log footage)

Media Pool Organization

Create bins mirroring the organized folder structure:

Crown Room/
  Establishing/
  Process/
  Detail/
  Transition/
  Aerial/
  Audio-Lav/
Memorial Tower/
  Talking Shots/    <-- Flag C0037 as "HERO"
  B-Roll/
    Establishing/
    Process/
    Detail/

Markers to Set

  • C0037 @ 1:00 -- "BEST AUDIO START" (red marker)
  • C0037 @ 1:50 -- "BEST AUDIO END" (red marker)
  • C0037 @ 0:40 -- "Speech picks up" (blue marker)
  • C0042 -- "Trane panel speech" (green marker)
  • C0043 -- "Trane panel speech 2" (green marker)
  • C0041 -- "HVAC walkthrough speech" (green marker)
  • C0017 -- "HERO FRAME" (yellow marker)
  • C0035 -- "Parking garage walk" (yellow marker)

Audio Processing

In Fairlight:

  1. Apply noise reduction to all talking clips (C0036-C0043). The mechanical room has a constant low-frequency hum from chillers/pumps.
  2. High-pass filter at 80Hz on all clips to cut rumble.
  3. The speech in C0042/C0043 is the cleanest. Use these for any standalone audio moments.
  4. DJI MIC recordings: if you want ambient crew audio under b-roll, apply mild compression to even out the volume swings.

Color Grade

All Ronin4D footage was shot at ISO 400, flat/log profile. The two locations have very different lighting:

  • Crown Room: Exterior rooftop, morning sun, blue sky. White balance 7700K (warm/golden). Expect warm tones.
  • Memorial Tower: Interior mechanical room, fluorescent/industrial lighting. Same 7700K WB but in mixed artificial light. Expect green/magenta color cast.

Grade these as two separate looks, unified by a common overall style. The drone footage has its own color science (DJI D-Log or normal).
